Class Gift

  • java.lang.Object
    • Gift
  • public class Gift
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents a gift that consists of different types of candies.

    The Gift class allows adding candies, sorting them, calculating total characteristics (price, weight, calories), and searching candies by their chocolate content percentage.
